name: 为他破戒，顾夫人惹不起
original_name: 为他破戒，顾夫人惹不起
overview: After being dumped by her boyfriend Shen Linfeng, Lu Wanxin discovers he immediately proposes to Ning Siyao, the heiress of the Ning Group. Heartbroken, she discovers she is the twin sister of Lu Wanhua, the behind-the-scenes power holder of the Jinyue Group. She is tasked with impersonating Lu Wanhua and becoming the true power behind the Jinyue Group. To get revenge on her boyfriend, Lu Wanxin agrees to appear at the Jinyue Group's bidding banquet hosted by the Ning Group, posing as the behind-the-scenes power holder. While humiliating everyone, she also manages to develop a real-life engagement with Gu Tingchen, the president of the Gu Group.
